# --output-htmx-helpers is a deprecated alias for --output-htmx: it still
# turns on the HTMX helpers and warns.

muxt generate --output-htmx-helpers

cmpenv stderr want-warning.txt

grep 'func.*HXRequest' template_routes.go

Flag --output-htmx-helpers has been deprecated, use --output-htmx instead
-- go.mod --
